name: infeara
description: Thirty-six Infeara skills — 23 expert personas plus a 10-role delivery team and orchestrator — for business, technology, security, audit, legal, marketing, and document work.

interface.longDescription: Infeara packages 36 skills into one plugin. The expert library covers chief executive, financial, technology and operating officers; founder and co-founder; marketing, sales, digital marketing (Google Ads and Meta Ads) and content; a professional document writer for cover pages, pagination, letterheads and brand typography; research and development, client success, business management and legal; lead auditor, CISO auditor and compliance; and cloud, DevOps, server, network and cyber security specialists. On top of that sits a delivery team of ten collaborating roles — engagement manager, solution architect, technical lead, implementation engineer, QA engineer, deployment engineer, documentation analyst, security analyst, project manager and account manager — coordinated by a team lead and a sprint orchestrator across discovery, design, build, verify, release, document and handover. Each skill supplies playbooks, templates, quality checklists and guardrails, and hands work to the roles that own adjacent decisions. The plugin runs entirely on packaged instructions: no network calls, no data collection, nothing stored outside the conversation. It does not execute code, sign contracts, file with a regulator, or replace qualified legal, financial or audit professionals; outputs are working drafts for a human to review.
capabilities: Expert guidance across 23 business and technology domains
Ten-role delivery team with defined handoffs and gates
Sprint planning, ceremonies and cross-role coordination
Test strategy, release and rollback planning
Security review and threat modelling for builds
Brand-compliant documents with cover pages and pagination
